170:         rv.voltage  = _read_number(_battery_acpi_path + '/voltage_now')
LaptopChargeStatus.msg 6: float32 voltage          # Voltage in Volts

notes: All four cited locations opened and match. Line 170 assigns the raw sysfs read of voltage_now with no scaling; LaptopChargeStatus.msg:6 declares 'float32 voltage  # Voltage in Volts' — the cited sources state volts. Line 220 '1 / 5.0' equals 0.2 Hz, and line 241 uses it as the loop rate of _check_batt_state, the thread that performs the battery-state read.
